title: Real line diffs for edits in the Claude pane
notes: Pane: chat-tools.ts:28 trims a common prefix and suffix, so two far-apart edits in one call show everything between them as changed. Use a proper line diff (no new dependency if a small LCS does it). Size S.

comments.body: PR #110: Edit and MultiEdit diffs in the Claude pane now use a line LCS, so far-apart changes show apart with a skipped-lines row between them. Version 2.15.0.
